message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India**

> **Official status:** Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any other Model S‑class vehicle) in India, so there is no published retail price from Tesla India.

If you’re looking for a rough estimate of what it might cost once it becomes available, you can use the U.S. price as a starting point and add the typical Indian import duties and taxes that apply to electric vehicles:

| Item | Approx. Cost (USD) | Notes |
|------|--------------------|-------|
| Base Model S (US MSRP) | $90,000–$100,000 | Depends on trim and options |
| Import duty (15 %) | $13,500–$15,000 | Standard for EVs |
| GST (18 %) | $16,200–$18,000 | Applied on the sum of base price + import duty |
| Additional fees (registration, road tax, etc.) | $1,000–$2,000 | Varies by state |

**Estimated total (USD)**: **≈ $120,700–$135,000**  
**Estimated total (INR)** (using ₹82 per USD): **≈ ₹9.9 crore – ₹11.1 crore**

> **Caveat:** These figures are purely illustrative. The actual price will depend on Tesla’s launch strategy, local manufacturing decisions, and any changes in duty rates or tax policy. Until Tesla officially announces a launch in India, the only reliable price is “not available.”
